summary: Extends the vCard contact format with properties defined by the Open Mobile Alliance (OMA) Converged Address Book group. These properties let contact fields that vCard did not already cover be synchronized using OMA Data Synchronization. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: An address book card had no spots for some facts that phones wanted to keep. This memo adds new spots so phones and computers can share the same contact cards.
